facebook.caption:
Walked down a temple alley off Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. Found Lemongrass Restaurant. 1,303 reviews and 4.6 stars. Not by accident.

Family-run. Real portions. The kind of spot locals point you to when you ask where they actually eat.

Phu Quoc has flashier restaurants. Few with this track record.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
